concepts.name: Enzymes
concepts.simple_definition: Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed up chemical reactions in living cells.
concepts.deep_explanation: They lower the activation energy required. They are proteins with specific active sites that bind to matching substrates.
concepts.real_example: Amylase in saliva breaks down starch into simple sugars during digestion.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking enzymes are consumed in reactions. They are reusable and remain unchanged.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ኢንዛይሞች በህይወት ባሉ ህዋሳት ውስጥ ኬሚካላዊ ግብረመልሶችን የሚያፋጥኑ ባዮሎጂያዊ አነቃቂዎች ናቸው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ግብረመልሱ የሚጠይቀውን አነስተኛ ኃይል (activation energy) ይቀንሳሉ። ኢንዛይሞች ፕሮቲኖች ናቸው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: በምራቅ ውስጥ የሚገኘው አሚሌዝ የተባለው ኢንዛይም በምግብ መፈጨት ወቅት ስታርች ወደ ስኳር እንዲቀየር ያደርጋል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: ኢንዛይሞች በግብረመልስ ጊዜ ያልቃሉ ብሎ ማሰብ። ኢንዛይሞች ደጋግመው ጥቅም ላይ መዋል ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: ANIMALS 1.4 Ethical Issues In Biology Et
concepts.simple_definition: BIOLOGY GRADE 11 UNIT 2: ANIMALS 1.4 Ethical issues in biology Ethical issues in biology are those issues that arise concerning the rightness or wrongness of using biological discoveries for the health and wellbeing of humans
concepts.deep_explanation: Ethical issues in biology deal with a variety of concerns related to biotechnology, medicine, and the environment including, the rightness or wrongness of using biotechnological information, products, or devices on human health and lifestyles and livelihood systems
